name: mp
description: Use external OpenAI-compatible and Anthropic-compatible LLM providers (CLIProxyAPI/CPA, OpenRouter, OpenAI, Gemini, DeepSeek, Groq, LiteLLM, Ollama) inside official Claude Desktop & Claude Code with a full LLM Providers & Model Catalog UI.

provider_name.title: Primary Provider Name
provider_name.description: Display label for your initial provider.

provider_api_key.title: Provider API Key
provider_api_key.description: Stored in your OS keychain (optional for local Ollama).

default_model.title: Default Model ID
default_model.description: Default external model ID for mp_chat.

dashboard_port.title: Settings Dashboard Port
dashboard_port.description: Loopback port for Settings Web UI.

gateway_port.title: Local Gateway Port
gateway_port.description: Loopback port for Claude Code CLI routing.

tools.name: mp_list_models
tools.description: List configured LLM providers and enabled/cached models.

tools.name: mp_chat
tools.description: Query any configured external LLM model.

tools.name: mp_compare_models
tools.description: Run 2-5 external models in parallel and compare outputs.

tools.name: mp_configure_provider
tools.description: Add/update providers or enable catalog models.

tools.name: mp_open_settings
tools.description: Open the local LLM Providers & Model Catalog Web Dashboard.

tools.name: mp_gateway_status
tools.description: Start or inspect the local Anthropic-compatible Gateway.
